_comment: TEMPLATE — Android App Links (Digital Asset Links). WS-5.7.
Host this at  https://<OWNED_DOMAIN>/.well-known/assetlinks.json  (HTTPS, content-type application/json, no redirect).
It lets the canonical https share link  https://<domain>/import?n=&d=  open KALI directly
(AndroidManifest needs an https intent-filter with android:autoVerify="true" alongside the kali:// one).
GO-LIVE TODO (Vasily — domain + keystore are hard-gates):
1. Register the owned domain (kali.app is parked/unowned) and set ShareConfig.linkBase + window.KALI_DIST.linkBase to it.
2. Replace REPLACE_WITH_RELEASE_SHA256_FINGERPRINT with the upload/release signing cert's SHA-256:
keytool -list -v -keystore <release.jks> -alias <alias>   (copy the SHA256 line, colon-separated upper-hex)
If enrolled in Play App Signing, ALSO add Google's app-signing-key SHA-256 (Play Console > App integrity) as a second fingerprint.
